node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: Node whose queue position should move.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: earliest: replay everything still retained. latest: skip everything queued. offset: move the partitions named in `offsets`.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Offset the node should resume from - the message at this offset is processed next.

offsets.title: Offsets
offsets.description: Required for mode=offset; ignored otherwise. Partitions not named keep their current position.
